versions.localizedDescription:
Stats for iPhone 0.3.6 adds an app identity footer to the dashboard Settings screen.

## What's Changed

- Show the Stats app icon, app name, version and build below the Settings controls.
- Read the displayed name and version from the installed app, so they stay current with future updates.

## Download

- **iPhone app · 0.3.6:** `Stats-v0.3.6-iOS.ipa` (iOS 17+, arm64; unsigned, requires signing through AltStore, SideStore, or another sideloading tool).
- **Mac companion · 0.3.9:** unchanged; get its signed DMG or ZIP from [v0.3.9](https://github.com/ishtiaq156/stats/releases/tag/v0.3.9).
- See the [README](https://github.com/ishtiaq156/stats#quick-start) for installation and pairing instructions.

**Full Changelog:** [Compare v0.3.11...v0.3.12](https://github.com/ishtiaq156/stats/compare/v0.3.11...v0.3.12)
